name: Multipurpose Full-Body Harness
desc: ABLE Model ULMP02 multipurpose full-body safety harness for fall arrest and work positioning. Medically designed to minimise wearer injury during and after a fall, with a medically-tested standing step that relieves suspension trauma, padded shoulder and leg straps, a large dorsal dee-ring, front belay loops, side pole-strap dees and a padded tool belt. High-tenacity 45 mm polyester pebble-weave webbing resists UV and common solvents; THETA-pattern stitching exceeds 28 kN; drop-forged, corrosion-resistant alloy-steel hardware with quick-release buckles. Harness WLL 600 kg (MBS 1500 kg); rated wearer capacity 160 kg (wearer + clothing + tools) when used with an ABLE shock-absorbing lanyard. Weight 2.45 kg. Certified and approved to ANSI Z359, EN 361 and AS/NZS 1891.1.
